scripts.start:backend: cd backend && SKIP_GARMIN_INIT=true REDIS_ENABLED=false .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build --prefix desktop && npm run dev --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: bash scripts/desktop-prepare.sh && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test:guardrails: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m unittest tests.test_sync_run_and_lock tests.test_no_asyncio_run_in_domain tests.test_sync_batch_commits tests.test_sync_checkpoint tests.test_alembic_migrations tests.test_runtime_hardening tests.test_layer_boundaries tests.test_security_headers tests.test_settings tests.test_metric_dependency_graph -v
scripts.ci:backend: cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check app/ && .venv/bin/mypy && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -c "from app.database.migrations import assert_single_alembic_head; assert_single_alembic_head()" && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_alembic_migrations.py tests/test_garmin_auth.py tests/test_telegram_notifier.py tests/test_activity_data_validation.py tests/test_metric_catalog_units.py tests/test_garmin_client_sync.py tests/test_coaching_hardening.py tests/test_coaching_v8.py tests/test_coaching_correctness.py tests/test_coaching_v9_operational.py tests/test_adaptive_coaching_v5.py tests/test_adaptive_coaching_v7.py tests/test_analysis_workspace_api.py -v --tb=short && bash scripts/ci_smoke_api.sh && PYTHONPATH=. SKIP_GARMIN_INIT=true .venv/bin/python -c "from app.main import app; assert app.title"
scripts.test:coaching: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_coaching_hardening.py tests/test_coaching_v8.py tests/test_coaching_correctness.py tests/test_coaching_v9_operational.py tests/test_adaptive_coaching_v5.py tests/test_adaptive_coaching_v7.py -v --tb=short
scripts.ci:frontend: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm exec --prefix frontend -- tsc --noEmit && npm test --prefix frontend -- --watchAll=false && npm run build --prefix frontend
